set.body:
Build the Friends input adapter into the common recorded pipeline, so Friends is a third film-recall study in the same bundle format (owner finish line, 2026-11-16). Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, section "Finish line: a usable representation for film recall studies".
Scope: turn the admitted Friends storyboard and recall workbook rows into the ordinary timed film descriptions and recall transcripts that agentStudyPrepare already accepts; make the 56-to-52 event crosswalk an explicit tested contract (docs/data/friends/README.md requires this before a loader emits event IDs). Development participants only, read through tools/recall-study/friends_guard.py; the sealed test side (docs/data/friends/test-split.json) is never opened. No participant recall or stimulus transcript enters the repository; inputs and outputs stay under the ignored data root (rule 14d).
Owner gate before any live model run: the Friends source set is still "proposed" (licence and REB basis open). Record the owner's basis for running a model on its development recall first. Preparation and offline tests do not need it.
Acceptance: one prepared Friends development study passes the same preparation checks as Sherlock and FilmFestival and yields a bundle of the same schema from a recorded or synthetic exchange, with a guard test showing a test-side read is refused. No new result format.
set.title: [detail-mapping] Friends input adapter into the common pipeline (development participants, guarded)
